title: Strategic Adaptability Negotiation Training
descriptions: We developed a negotiation training on strategic adaptability, titled "Strategic Adaptability Negotiation Training in Purchasing and Supply Management: A Multi-Method Instructional Approach". The paper can be accessed at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pursup.2024.100968. We share all teaching materials here. This includes: 1) Lecture slides, including links to the video clips 3) Questions to guide class discussions, and detailed video and debriefing instructions 4) Implementation-intention exercise 5) Simulation and its debriefing guidelines
